name: LCI Industries
summary: LCI Industries, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies engineered components for the manufacturers of recreational vehicles (RVs) and adjacent industries in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) and Aftermarket. The OEM segment manufactures and distributes a range of engineered components, such as steel chassis, axles, anti-lock braking systems, and suspension systems; manual, electric, and hydraulic stabilizer and leveling systems; awnings, slide-out mechanisms, and accessories; vinyl, aluminum, and frameless windows; entry, luggage, patio, and ramp doors; electric and manual entry steps and awnings…
